epicRings.name: Ring of Epic Protection +6
epicRings.derive:
Epic Protection: This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +6 to AC.

Strong abjuration; CL 18th; Forge Ring, Forge Epic Ring, shield of faith, caster must be of a level at least three times greater than the bonus of the ring; Price 720,000 gp.
